name: bun
title: Bun
enablers: This plugin is enabled when a `bun.lock` or `bun.lockb` file is found or a `bun test` script is configured.

name: github-actions
title: GitHub Actions
enablers: This plugin is enabled when a `.yml` or `.yaml` file is found in the `.github/workflows` folder.

name: mcp
title: MCP
enablers: This plugin is enabled when `.mcp.json`, `.cursor/mcp.json`, `.vscode/mcp.json` or `.codex/config.toml` is found.

name: mise
title: mise
enablers: This plugin is enabled when `mise.toml` or `.mise.toml` is found.

name: openclaw
title: OpenClaw
enablers: This plugin is enabled when `package.json#openclaw` is present.

name: pnpm
title: pnpm
enablers: This plugin is enabled when a `pnpm-lock.yaml` or `pnpm-workspace.yaml` file is found in the root directory, or when `pnpm@` is specified in the `packageManager` field of `package.json`.

name: taskfile
title: Taskfile
enablers: This plugin is enabled when a Taskfile is found (Taskfile.yml, taskfile.yml, Taskfile.yaml, taskfile.yaml, etc.).

name: travis
title: Travis CI
enablers: This plugin is enabled when a `.travis.yml` file is found in the root folder.

name: typescript-content-mapper
title: TypeScript Content Mapper
enablers: This plugin is enabled when `package.json#typescript.contentMapper` is present.

name: unplugin-vue-router
title: unplugin-vue-router
isEnabled:
({ cwd, dependencies }) => hasDependency(dependencies, ['unplugin-vue-router']) ||
    (hasDependency(dependencies, ['vue-router']) && findGeneratedDts(cwd, 'Generated by vue-router').length > 0)

name: yarn
title: Yarn
enablers: This plugin is enabled when a `yarn.lock` file is found in the root directory, or when `yarn@` is specified in the `packageManager` field of `package.json`.
